summary: Fixed the corrupted /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance script (it contained a botched heredoc with literal setup commands baked in as text and was not executable), installed a root crontab entry to run it daily at 02:15 appending to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log, verified crond is active/enabled, and confirmed via a controlled reboot of node1 that the cron job, script, and log persist and function after restart.
actions_performed: Inspected /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance and found it corrupted (literal heredoc remnants) and not executable
Rewrote the script with correct content, set ownership root:root and mode 0755
Verified script runs successfully and prints expected output
Confirmed crond service active and enabled
Triggered a safe systemd reboot on node1 (acknowledged before disconnect)
Polled until node1 was reachable again and confirmed boot_id changed
Re-verified crond active/enabled, crontab entry intact, script executable and functional, log file intact post-reboot

evidence.requirement: Script /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance exists, is valid, and executable
evidence.summary: Found script corrupted and non-executable; rewrote it, set mode 0755, and confirmed it runs and produces the expected output

evidence.requirement: Cron schedules the script daily at 02:15 and output is retained in /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log
evidence.summary: Installed root crontab entry '15 2 * * * /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance >> /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log 2>&1' and created the log file with correct ownership/permissions; crond confirmed active and enabled
Captured boot_id 5fb1b173-c1c8-4647-b118-0145511f0fcc, confirmed crond active, crontab entry present, script and log files in place
Issued backgrounded 'systemctl reboot' so acknowledgement returned before disconnection

evidence.requirement: node1 changed boot identity after restart
evidence.summary: Connection timed out mid-reboot, then boot_id read as 4b480296-1270-4d64-9c4e-a75a4578c8e1, differing from baseline, proving the node rebooted

evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery of required services and data
evidence.summary: After reboot, crond active/enabled, crontab entry intact, script executable and runs correctly, log file intact
